claim: AC1: MemoryConfig in src/sqllens/config.py carries a new float field context_similarity_threshold with pydantic Field bounds ge=0.0, le=1.0, defaulting to 0.7 (via _DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD).
AC2: context_similarity_threshold is settable via env SQLLENS_MEMORY__CONTEXT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD and via the [memory] TOML key, with env winning over TOML.

AC3: when context_similarity_threshold >= similarity_threshold the band is empty (band_enabled = context_floor < strict is False) and no extra memory is injected on account of the band; at the default 0.7/0.7 output is byte-identical to pre-change.

AC4: when context_similarity_threshold < similarity_threshold the enhancer injects memories scoring in [context_floor, strict) from both question->SQL pairs and text/schema-doc memories under the existing '## Relevant Context from Memory' heading.
AC5: injected near-match question->SQL pairs render as related example prose (prior question and its SQL), not as a pre-decided tool call.

AC6: question->SQL pairs with score >= similarity_threshold are excluded from the band (r.similarity_score < strict filter) and stay tool-only; text memories at or above strict remain injected as before.

AC7 (INTENTIONALLY DEFERRED): docs/internal/agent/memory.md updated to describe the injection path and context_similarity_threshold. Per this run's prior decision AC7 is deferred; missing docs must NOT be graded a code defect.
The enhancer calls search_text_memories with keyword-only similarity_threshold; the AgentMemory ABC declares that keyword-only parameter, so the call is signature-valid.
The enhancer calls search_similar_usage(question=..., context=..., limit=5, similarity_threshold=context_floor) with keyword-only args matching the AgentMemory ABC / ChromaAgentMemory signature.
The band render reads pair.args['sql'] guarded by isinstance(r.memory.args, dict) and r.memory.args.get('sql'); ToolMemory.args is typed Dict[str, Any] and question is str, so no unguarded deref.

factory.build_agent constructs DefaultLlmContextEnhancer(memory, similarity_threshold=cfg.memory.similarity_threshold, context_similarity_threshold=cfg.memory.context_similarity_threshold) and passes it to Agent(..., llm_context_enhancer=context_enhancer); Agent accepts that kwarg.
_StubAgentMemory's search_text_memories/search_similar_usage mirror the real AgentMemory keyword-only signatures and reproduce the real ChromaAgentMemory '>= similarity_threshold' lower-bound gate.
_StubAgentMemory implements all abstract AgentMemory methods (save_tool_usage, save_text_memory, get_recent_memories, etc.) so it instantiates, with signatures matching the ABC.

_render_text_only reproduces the exact pre-change text-only '## Relevant Context from Memory' section string, so the no-op assertions pin byte-identical output rather than self-referencing the code under test.

test_memory_thresholds_flow_into_context_enhancer asserts agent.llm_context_enhancer is a DefaultLlmContextEnhancer with similarity_threshold==0.6, context_similarity_threshold==0.3, and shares agent.agent_memory.

_DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD is defined as 0.7 in BOTH src/sqllens/config.py and src/sqllens/agent/core/enhancer/default.py (two independent literals across the vendored-agent boundary); each module's comment calls it a 'single source of truth' within that module.
